{{Top|leg}}
'''Castrella''' was [[Shelby Tribold]]'s lover, and accompanied Tribold to find [[Elbren BaChorin]]. Castrella was initially frightened by BaChorin's appearance, but was reassured by Tribold.<ref name="H&R">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
